metadataCidReproduction.method: Solidity 0.6.12 standard JSON compile of Blockscout API source payloads using the returned compiler settings; CID computed with ipfs-only-hash, then compared with the IPFS multihash embedded in onchain runtime CBOR.
metadataCidReproduction.interpretation: The public explorer source and compiler settings reproduce exact source metadata for the proxy and linked library. For FiatTokenV2_2, the generated metadata commitment differs despite matching executable runtime bytes before metadata; source/metadata inputs for the implementation do not yet reproduce the onchain commitment.

prepare: Clone circlefin/stablecoin-evm and check out release-2026-08-12T202509 (fc85788bc7c23cefe3df1a757133048bfddadeaa).
Run corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile; Circle setup installs its pinned Foundry nightly and submodules.
At block 48021662, retrieve eth_getCode for the proxy, implementation, and linked SignatureChecker addresses into local files.

Run hardhat verifyOnChainBytecode for each component with --verification-type partial; for FiatTokenV2_2 provide --library-name SignatureChecker and the observed --library-address; for SignatureChecker use --is-library true.
reproduction.expected: Each Circle verifier invocation reports that supplied partial runtime bytecode is consistent with the local version.

assuranceBoundary: This is read-only testnet code identity evidence at one pinned block, not a deployment or token-use approval.
It does not prove the asset has financial value, that an operator controls funded USDC, or that any deployment has occurred.
Full CBOR/IPFS metadata and exact source-input equivalence remain unresolved.
The public Circle release source files are not proven byte-identical to the deployed proxy source snapshot; the retrieved metadata records four differing Circle source hashes.
